items.title: Is General Mills’ (GIS) PB+J Reese’s Puffs a Clue to Its “Fewer, Bigger Bets” Strategy?
items.summary: General Mills recently launched a limited-edition Reese’s Puffs PB+J cereal across US retailers, blending peanut butter, chocolate, and strawberry jelly with in-pack temporary tattoos to tap into nostalgia and back-to-school demand. This short-run product extension highlights how General Mills is using fewer, bigger innovations in its cereal portfolio to support brand engagement and potential incremental sales.
